 Gifts
 Gift (Act) Received 2024/04/18 
 Nature
 Ticket to the Indspire Awards ceremony on April 18, 2024 in Ottawa.
 Source
 CEO of the Aboriginal Peoples Television Network.
 Circumstances
 I presented an Indspire Health award to Lea Bill. 
 Gift (Act) Received 2022/11/20 
 Nature
 One ticket to attend the following events in relation to the Canadian Football League (CFL) Grey Cup on November 20, 2022, in Regina, Saskatchewan:
• The CFL Commissioner's Tailgate Brunch
• The Grey Cup game 
The invitation also gave access to the Commissioner's Lounge throughout the game, local transportation to and from the hotel to the events and included a water bottle, toque, scarf and Hot Poc cell phone warming pouch
 Source
 The Canadian Football League
 Circumstances
 Attended the events and spoke in my capacity as Minister as a representative of the Federal Government at the Commissioner’s brunch. 
 Gift (Forfeited) Received 2020/02/12 
 Nature
 A marble carving of a bear by artist Paul Maliki from Naujaat, Nunavut
 Source
 Kono Tattuinee, President of the Kivalliq Inuit Association
 Circumstances
 During an official meeting while visiting the Kivalliq region for the first time
 The records for all 4 declared gifts are available in the Declarations and Other Documents section below. 
 Travel
 Travel on a non-commercial chartered or private aircraft
Flight from Winnipeg to Pimicikamak Cree Nation, Manitoba on September 14, 2024 to attend the funeral of Grand Chief of the Assembly of Manitoba Chiefs Cathy Merrick.
Source: the Assembly of Manitoba Chiefs.
I was accompanied by Brad Boudreau, senior policy advisor.
This travel was required in my capacity as Minister of Northern Affairs, Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, and Minister responsible for the Canadian Northern Economic Development Agency.
